title: What is connected TV? How CTV advertising works | Amazon Ads

facts.fact: The page defines connected TV (CTV) advertising as ads shown on devices such as smart TVs or mobile phones that allow brands to reach streaming audiences.
facts.quote: Connected TV (CTV) advertising refers to ads shown on devices such as smart TVs or mobile phones that allow brands to reach streaming audiences.

facts.fact: Amazon Ads states that budget minimums apply to its managed services, which are available to advertisers with limited experience on request.
facts.quote: If you have limited experience, contact us to request services managed by Amazon Ads. Budget minimums apply.

facts.fact: The page defines streaming TV (STV) as the digital distribution of video content across devices with an Internet connection, rather than a cable signal.
facts.quote: Streaming TV (STV) is the digital distribution of video content across devices with an Internet connection, rather than a cable signal.

facts.fact: According to the page, OTT describes how content is distributed over the Internet, while CTV describes the device used to view that content.
facts.quote: The difference between OTT and CTV is that the former refers to how the content is distributed over the Internet, meaning video content that is streamed without traditional satellite or cable providers. The latter is the device used to view that content, like a gaming console or smart TV, for example.

facts.fact: The page states that Amazon streaming TV ads are currently purchased programmatically, meaning they are bought and sold digitally by an automated system.
facts.quote: Currently, Amazon streaming TV ads are purchased programmatically, meaning that the ads are bought and sold digitally by an automated system.

facts.fact: The page defines cost per completed view (CPCV) as the measure of the price of each completed ad.
facts.quote: CPCV measures the price of each completed ad.

facts.fact: The page claims that the video completion rate of CTV ads tends to be very high because many streaming services do not allow ads to be skipped; no numeric rate is given.
facts.quote: The VCR of CTV ads tend to be very high, since many streaming services do not allow ads to be skipped.
